body: Owner asked on 2026-11-11 to fix the recommendations. (1) A claim replaced by another machine's claim is reported and shown in the loser's brief. (2) One unreadable record file is skipped, the rest of the load goes on. (4) A config written by a newer sati says "update sati", not only "Invalid".
